reason: The current AttentiveSimilarity model scores 0.4412 macro validation HR@10 versus SASRec's 0.505, with the largest deficit on Movies_and_TV; its permutation-invariant aggregation motivates testing whether purchase order supplies missing information. Modify model_design to add the proposed gated causal encoder while preserving candidate-conditioned similarity, drawing on historical success with conservative gated fusion. Modify training_evaluation for matching checkpoint reconstruction and controlled comparison, avoiding the additional final-state scoring branch, recency weighting, and sampling changes associated with unsuccessful experiments.

plan.model_design: Extend AttentiveSimilarity with learned positional embeddings and exactly one causal Transformer block, preserving context, target, bias, history_key, candidate_key, forward(self, history, candidates), and predict(self, history, candidates), with only optional trailing constructor configuration arguments. Encode the existing ordered history using dim=DIM, one attention head, a feed-forward width of 2*dim, and dropout 0.1; process nonempty histories without fully masked attention rows, scatter encoded tokens back to their original positions, and explicitly zero padding outputs. Project and normalize the encoded states to the context embedding scale, then compute a feature-wise sigmoid gate over concatenated original and encoded context embeddings and blend them as fused = ((1-g)*context + g*encoded)*mask.unsqueeze(-1), initializing gate weights to zero and bias to -2 to favor the original similarity representation initially. Feed fused into the existing history_key and pair_scores calculations while retaining the candidate-conditioned attention formula, square-root normalization, separate context and target tables, and item bias unchanged. This isolates order-aware token contextualization without adding the failed historical final-state scoring branch, recency buckets, temporal decay, embedding-role changes, or new scoring objectives.

Keep PurchaseDataset, its prefix-only targets, ordered subsampling, context dropout, NEGATIVES=64, sampled cross-entropy, embedding regularization, AdamW settings, batch size, early stopping, and runtime limits fixed; the historical 16-negative configuration must not replace the current implementation. Preserve preprocessing seed 0 and per-category seed_everything(42), DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four categories, supplied splits, trial-local WORKING artifacts, single-GPU execution, and the SASREC_EPOCHS default of 200 within the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget.
